content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Payment Gateway Customer ## slug: stripe-customer ## seoTitle: ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End :::(Info) (Matching Rule Update) Users upgrading Payments will need to manually deactivate the current Payment Gateway Customer Dup Rule matching rule and activate the new Payment_Gateway_Customer_Matching_Rule2 matching rule. The new matching rule will be installed automatically for new installations. ::: The {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}} object connects your {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} customers' ({{variable.Object_Account}}s and/or {{variable.Object_Contact}}s) with your {{variable.Product_Stripe}} customers' accounts. {{variable.Product_Stripe}} maintains a single entity by which cards, payments, and all other {{variable.Product_Stripe}} records relate to (something like a {{variable.Object_PersonAccount}} in {{variable.Product_Salesforce}}). All {{variable.Product_Stripe}} related data ultimately relates back to a {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}} record (except with Stripe Connect). This object works mainly in the background and requires no user setup. For example, a new {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}} will either trigger the creation of a new {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}} record or relate to an existing one based on the {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}'s {{variable.Field_PM_Email}} and related {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}}. :::(Warning) (Note on Account, Contact, and Lead Matching) In Payments version 4.163 and above, we no longer use hard-coded logic (Email and First Name) to match Payment Gateway Customers to Accounts, Contacts, or Leads when these lookup fields are blank. The matching will now use your active standard or custom Salesforce Duplicate Rules and their associated Matching Rules. Click [here](https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=sf.matching_rules_standard_rules.htm&type=5){target="_blank"} to learn more about the criteria evaluated in the Salesforce Standard Matching rules. Click [here](https://help.salesforce.com/s/articleView?id=sf.matching_rules_create.htm&type=5){target="_blank"} to learn more about creating custom matching rules and click here to learn how to use those matching rules in custom Duplicate Rules. ::: ## Matching, PGC Records, and the Mobile Payments App To prevent duplicate {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}} (PGC) records from being created when using the Mobile Payments app and a card reader, the following changes were made. * If a payment is submitted and a {{variable.Object_Contact}} or {{variable.Object_Account}} is selected, the {{variable.Object_Contact}}/{{variable.Object_Account}} will be related so future payments are matched to the existing PGC, preventing duplicate PGC records from being generated. * If a PGC record can't be matched to an id, we will attempt to match the PGC record against the parent {{variable.Object_Contact}}/{{variable.Object_Account}} and use the parent’s PGC record instead of creating a new record. If we find an exact match, we will reuse the existing PGC record. ### Example The following records exist: PGC 1 is related to {{variable.Object_Account}} 1 and {{variable.Object_Contact}} 3. * Scenario 1: If a new {{variable.Object_Transaction}} is created. It is related to only {{variable.Object_Contact}} 3. The {{variable.Object_Transaction}} would generate a new PGC record called PGC 2. * Scenario 2: A second Transaction is created. {{variable.Object_Transaction}} 2 is related to {{variable.Object_Account}} 1 and {{variable.Object_Contact}} 3. {{variable.Object_Transaction}} 2 will use PGC 1. * Scenario 3: A third {{variable.Object_Transaction}} is created. {{variable.Object_Transaction}} 3 is only related to {{variable.Object_Contact}} 3. {{variable.Object_Transaction}} 3 will use PGC 2. ## About the Payment Gateway Customer Record ![H_01_08 payment gateway customer](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_01_08%20payment%20gateway%20customer.png){height="" width=""} 1. Navigate to the {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}} object. ***Lightning:** Click on the App Launcher | Under "All Items" | Click on Payment Gateway Customers.* ***Classic:** Click on "All Tabs" ("+" icon in the top right) | Click on Payment Gateway Customers.* 2. Click on the {{variable.Field_PGC_Name}} of any {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}}. *If you don't see any {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}} records, that means you have not created any [Payment Methods](/v1/docs/payment-methods) or [synced](/v1/docs/historical-sync) any data from {{variable.Product_Stripe}}.* - {{variable.Field_PGC_Email}} and {{variable.Field_PGC_Description}} are the only two fields on the record that will update between {{variable.Product_Stripe}} and {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} when [Webhooks](/v1/docs/quick-start) is configured. - The "Related To" fields {{variable.Field_PGC_Account}} and {{variable.Field_PGC_Contact}} are lookup type fields to the standard {{variable.Object_Account}} and {{variable.Object_Contact}} objects. *They are automatically filled in from the related {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}'s {{variable.Field_PM_Contact}} and/or {{variable.Field_PM_Account}} values.* - {{variable.Field_PGC_AccountBalance}}: The customer's current balance. - {{variable.Field_PGC_Coupon}}: When defined, the customer will have a discount applied on all recurring charges. - {{variable.Field_PGC_InvoicePrefix}}: The prefix for the customer used to generate unique invoice numbers. - {{variable.Field_PGC_BillingPostalCode}} **Note** Place the {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}} object on your {{variable.Object_Account}} and {{variable.Object_Contact}} page layouts as a [Related List](https://success.salesforce.com/answers?id=90630000000wkYLAAY) if you have multiple {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}}s. Since there can only be one {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}} to one {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}}, you will be able to tell which {{variable.Object_Account}}s and/or {{variable.Object_Contact}}s are on more than one {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}}. ## Create a Payment Gateway Customer ![Create a Stripe Customer Record](https://youtu.be/tBNa_di8M-g){height="480" width="640"} ### Option 1 1. Navigate to the {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}} object. ***Lightning:** Click on the App Launcher > Under "All Items" > Click on Payment Gateway Customers.* ***Classic:** Click on "All Tabs" ("+" icon in the top right) > Click on Payment Gateway Customers.* 2. Click {{variable.button_new}}. 3. Populate the {{variable.Field_PGC_Name}}, {{variable.Field_PGC_PaymentGateway}}, {{variable.Field_PGC_Email}}, and {{variable.Field_PGC_Description}} fields. *If you want to relate this {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}} to an existing {{variable.Object_Account}} and/or {{variable.Object_Contact}}, add the existing record(s) under the "Related To" section.* 4. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. This record will sync with your {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} and the {{variable.Field_PGC_CustomerID}} and {{variable.Field_PGC_CreatedInGateway}} fields will auto-populate. ### Option 2 1. Add the {{variable.Object_Account}}’s billing and shipping addresses. ![H_01_08_Option 2_1](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_01_08_Option%202_1.png){height="" width=""} 2. Create and set a {{variable.Object_Contact}} to be the Primary Stripe Contact. ![H_01_08_Option 2_2](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_01_08_Option%202_2.png){height="" width=""} 3. On the {{variable.Object_Account}} click the **Create Stripe Customer** button. ![H_01_08_Option 2_3](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_01_08_Option%202_3.png){height="" width=""} 4. Confirm that a {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}} was created and related to the {{variable.Object_Account}}. ![H_01_08_Option 2_4](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/H_01_08_Option%202_4.png){height="" width=""} ### Option 3 1. Add the {{variable.Button_PG_PushtoGateway}} button to your {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}} page layout. 2. Navigate to Custom Settings > Blackthorn Pay - Trigger Settings > Manage > Edit > Enable `Disable Creating a Stripe Customer`. 3. Navigate to the {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}} object. 4. Click {{variable.button_new}}. 5. Populate the {{variable.Field_PGC_Name}}, {{variable.Field_PGC_PaymentGateway}}, {{variable.Field_PGC_Email}}, and {{variable.Field_PGC_Description}} fields. 6. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. 7. Click {{variable.Button_PG_PushtoGateway}}. 8. Click the **Push** button on the Visualforce page. 9. After the success message displays and you return to the {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}} record, the {{variable.Field_PGC_CustomerID}} and {{variable.Field_PGC_CreatedInGateway}} fields will auto-populate. :::(Info) (Updating a Payment Gateway Customer Record) Using Option 3 without performing Step 2 will also work if the initial trigger action never happened or if you are updating the Payment Gateway Customer record and you notice that the update did not make it to the Payment Gateway. ::: ## Remove a Payment Gateway Customer Once a {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}} record in {{variable.Product_Salesforce}} has synced to the {{variable.Product_Stripe}} {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}}, you are unable to delete the record. If you need to remove a {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}} for any reason, that can be done by clicking the {{variable.Button_PGC_RemoveFromGateway}} button or checking the {{variable.Field_PGC_RemovefromGateway}} checkbox. This functionality was created so historical information can be kept while ceasing all ways to capture transactions. 1. Navigate to the {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}}'s object. ***Lightning:** Click on the app launcher > Under "All Items" > Click on Payment Gateway Customers.* ***Classic:** Click on "All Tabs" ("+" icon in the top right) > Click on Payment Gateway Customers.* **{{variable.SFTerm_RelatedList}}** on your {{variable.Object_Account}} or {{variable.Object_Contact}} page layout. * Click on the record you want to remove from {{variable.Product_Stripe}}. * Click {{variable.Button_PGC_RemoveFromGateway}} button or check the {{variable.Field_PGC_RemovefromGateway}} field. *Clicking this button will invalidate any related {{variable.Object_PaymentMethod}}'s on file.* * The {{variable.Field_PGC_DeletedPaymenGateway}} field will be checked, letting you know this {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}} is no longer valid. **Notes** If the {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}} had any related {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s that were captured, those records will still be in the {{variable.Product_Stripe}} {{variable.Object_PaymentGateway}} and the Customer account will show an alert, "This customer account has been permanently closed". If you have any "Open" {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s that are set to [Auto-Process](/v1/docs/transaction-reattempt-logic) and related to this {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}} record, they will fail. Verify all related "Open" {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s have been deleted once you click the {{variable.Button_PGC_RemoveFromGateway}} button. ## Troubleshooting If you have received an error with your {{variable.Object_PaymentGatewayCustomer}} or have a question, please view our [Troubleshooting](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/payments-troubleshooting){target=`_blank`} or [FAQ](https://docs.blackthorn.io/docs/payments-faq){target=`_blank`} page.
